definitions.gloss: piece of meat; slice of meat
definitions.explanation: A cut or piece of meat, typically referring to a slice, chunk, or strip used in cooking.

examples.japanese: {肉片|にくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put the pieces of meat into the pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧{肉片|にくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Quickly grill thin slices of meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{肉片|にくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ごろごろ→ごろごろ：05176_gorogoro⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦シチュー→シチュー：10931_shichuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a stew with big chunks of meat throughout.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) and {片|へん} (piece, fragment). Used in cooking and food descriptions to refer to cut or sliced pieces of meat. The {片|へん} suffix appears in other food-related compounds like {魚片|ぎょへん} (piece of fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉片|にくへん}: thinly sliced pieces of meat
- {肉片|にくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry pieces of meat
- {肉片|にくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧: to stew pieces of meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: meat (general) — the basic word, does not imply it is cut into pieces
- ⟦{切|き}り{身|み}→切り身：21110_kirimi⟧: fillet, cut of meat or fish — more specific to a prepared cut
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: thinly sliced meat — specifies the cutting method
- ⟦{角切|かくぎ}り→角切り：08086_kakugiri⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: cubed meat — specifies the shape of the cut
